text:
Sam (PM): quick intake — AcmeCorp saw a quality regression after we flipped them to the q4 variant. they want a safe rollout pattern with clear cutoffs. need problem statement, goals, non-goals, and acceptance criteria. cc @Jamie @Sara @Priya

Jamie (Eng): ok — do we want this as a per-tenant canary or per-model? also thinking about autoscale interactions during canary traffic.

Sam (PM): prefer per-tenant first (customer-requested isolation). per-model later as infra work. main ask: automatic rollback if quality drops or if latency spikes beyond threshold.

Sara (ML): draft problem statement: "When switching to certain quantized variants, downstream prompt suites show regressions for specific intents (billing/accounting). Need guardrails to detect regressions within rollout window and automatically rollback to previous variant with minimal customer impact."

Priya (CS): confirming scope: AcmeCorp requires audit trail + quick rollback. they want notifications to their SRE and ours. non-goals: changing prompt data or retraining for this feature.

Mike (Solutions): ops constraints: rollback must not leak tokens or partial responses. also want a canary sample size proposal — suggest 5% of traffic for 10k requests minimum over 30 minutes.

Sara (ML): proposed goals / success metrics (sketch):
- quality delta on core eval set <= 1.5% drop (intent-level F1 or custom score)
- user-visible regen rate <= 0.5% absolute increase
- p95 latency increase <= 25ms
- automatic rollback completes < 5 minutes after cutoff triggered

Sam (PM): non-goals (explicit):
- retraining models or changing base weights
- cross-tenant model routing changes
- deep root-cause analysis (that will be follow-up)

Jamie (Eng): acceptance criteria draft (to implement + test):

```
- Canary launch config present in Console for tenant (percent + min-requests + duration)
- Metrics pipeline: per-tenant eval set runs continuously during canary, emits quality_score, regen_rate, and latency
- Cutoff rules: if (quality_score_drop > 1.5) OR (regen_rate_increase > 0.5) OR (p95_latency_increase > 25ms) for a sliding 10m window -> trigger rollback
- Rollback action: switch traffic to previous variant, notify ops + customer, record audit event with reason
- Tests: unit + e2e that simulate quality drop and assert rollback and notification within 5m
```

Priya (CS): add customer acceptance: they want an option to opt into manual hold (so we don't rollback automatically if they want to handle manually). need a flag on tenant config.

Sam (PM): good — include a tenant-level policy: {auto_rollback: on/off} and default on for newest customers. (we'll capture as config later)

Mike (Solutions): edge cases to call out:
- low traffic tenants where min-sample not met -> fallback to canary-by-count threshold or require manual approval
- noisy metrics during infra incidents -> tie to infra-health signal to suppress auto-rollback
- partial failures where only sub-intents regress -> allow scoped rollback by intent if model supports routing

Sara (ML): testing notes: need a synthetic harness to inject controlled regressions into eval set and a replay of live traffic to validate detection latency.

Jamie (Eng): implementation notes: will add a new route in rollout service to support per-tenant canaries + cutoff eval worker. timeline? estimate 3 wks dev + 1 wk infra testing.

Sam (PM): timeline sounds fine for initial MVP. deliverables for PRD: problem statement, goals/non-goals, acceptance criteria, tenant policy options, test plan, rollout UI mockups.

Priya (CS): i'll coordinate a call with AcmeCorp on Wed to confirm opt-in behavior and notification list.

ops-bot: scheduled: canary-guarding-discussion created for Wed 15:00 UTC, attendees: Sam, Jamie, Sara, Priya, Mike

Sam (PM): thanks all — i'll turn this into a short PRD draft and post for review before Wed. please add any missing edge cases here."
